[quote=sikirsk;59804144][b]Mobilisation[/b]

Following the Heavy escalation over our peacekeeping mission. We have started our full mobilisation. We were Semi-mobilised at all times. But now we must defend our democratic rights to be free and to secure our interests.

General defense infrastructure has been mobilized with forts, anti-air, aswell as airplanes now having entered the skies to defend our airspace. Communication security has been secured with the Federal Intelligence Department (FID) now encrypting our sensitive data and military intel. While also looking into more [b][u]External[/u][/b] operations.

The Grand Army shall hold.

Glory to the Federation.[/quote]
[quote=sikirsk;59804241][b]Walkin'[/b]

While the 4th Army enters the Enkian capital, although losses were made, professional teams were able to counter the semi-geriullia warfare in the region. 

While the Army entered the final stretch, the government building, with most its government members still inside it, the airforce was making one last pass upon the building. And a large speaker was heard to those inside:

This is the Sikirskian Army, your tactics have been proven useless, this city is cleared and we are ready to destroy that building you are all in. 

I will start a countdown from 10 seconds, if you do not surrender, those planes you see will bomb that building to shreads.

Final warning this is.

10...
9...
8...
7...
6.
5...
4...
3.....
2-
(I shall await your reaction) [nation]Enkia[/nation].[/quote]

Your march to the capital has been anything but easy. IEDs hide in cloverts, bushes, any small clutter along the roads likely hid a mine or explosive. Mortars rained down on you, you come across abandoned firing positions, empty mortar tubes abandoned but the people gone. Signs containing curses against you litter your path forward. As you enter the city, you can hear a deep reverberating tone, a chant of a thousand voices, hailing from the capital building.
The building was a large pyramid covered in tapestries, that now burn to ash. As you mount your final push you can see people; Civilians, soldiers, public officials. They all chant a single word that they let reverberate through the pyramid, and as you speak over the loud speaker you can still hear it rattle your chest.
"[b]RAAAAUUUUMMMMMMM, RAAAAUUUMMMMMMM![/b]"
The High Priest Malchadorus stands, Hoisting the new Flag of Enkia.
"WE DO NOT FEAR DEATH, FOR IT IS NOT OUR END!" He calls as the chanting subsides.
"[b]AVE SATANAS![/b]" The people responded as you can hear a thousand safeties clicking off.
"OUR SOULS ARE NOT SHACKLED AS THE ENEMIES ARE, SO WE WILL ASCEND ABOVE THEM!" He holds aloft a saber made of gold as the flag flutters behind him.
"[b]AVE SATANAS!![/b]" The shouldering of rifles is heard, the roofs open up, more mortar systems, and jurry rigged ant air guns made of stolen Sikirskian heavy machine guns.
"[b]ALL THE DEMONS IN HELL HAVE DECREED; ON THIS DAY ENKIA STANDS![/b]"
The hail of mortars, homemade rockets, the automatic rifle and machine gun fire do nothing to silence the battle cry of the enkians;
"[b]Ave Satanas, Enkia Stands.[/b]"

[quote=dhornaper;59793199][B]Alavi's Arrival to the Directorate[/b]

Alavi changes clothes and is out on the street within minutes. He runs as fast as he can to the Directorate of Intelligence offices. When he arrives, he sees three soldiers at the front who block the entrance.

"No entry, go home!"

"I'm Director Alavi, this is my Directorate. Do you want to stand in the way of a Director doing his job? You will be court martialled."

The soldiers exchange looks. "Come with me" one of the soldiers says as he leads Director Alavi inside. The soldier takes Alavi to his sergeant at the reception.

"Sir, the Director is here."

The sergeant looks at Director Alavi. "You are Director Alavi?"

"Yes, I'm here on order of the President."

The sergeant thinks for a moment. "The President's government and position have been dissolved. You're not going anywhere Mr. Alavi." He turns to the soldier "zip tie him to the chair and make sure he goes stays here."

"Yes sir." With that, the soldier grabs Alavi and forces him to his seat before zip tying one of his hands to the chair.

Alavi is stunned and, seeing that he has no escape from the heavily armed soldiers, chooses not to fight his way out. His attempt to save the government is over.

[B]Inside the Army Headquarter's[/b]

The general staff are in disarray. They had no knowledge of the coup and have no idea what is happening. What they do know is that soldiers have occupied the building and no one can go in or out.

"How many units are involved?"
"Is General Fereydun acting on his own or are other generals across the country involved too?"
"Is the air force and navy involved?"

Eventually, a soldier walks in and announces that they must all go to the auditorium. General Fereydun will be there soon.

The general staff stay silent before slowly trickling their way to the auditorium. Not long after, General Fereydun arrives and makes his way to the auditorium stage.

He stands there for a moment, surveying the room before speaking.

"The rest of the army has taken control of the administration and the capital is under control. If you do not support this, you may announce it now and retire from the army without prejudice, no matter your rank."

General Fereydun waits, confident that, as in earlier meetings with his colonels and majors and at the parade field of Major Siamak's company, no one would announce their opposition. After a moment of prolonged silence, General Fereydun continues.

"I will lead the tranistionary government. Order all generals and colonels of the army, all generals of the air force, and all admirals of the navy to present themselves here by tomorrow 12:00 or their reisgnations will be accepted. All generals and colonels present are to remain in the headquarters."

With that, he dismisses the assembled officers who disperse and make a flurry of orders for radio messages and messengers to go out in person to deliver General Fereydun's order. General Fereydun leaves the auditorium and turns towards a staffer passing by. "Prepare a room with ten chairs and a single desk."

"Yes sir."

[B]The President Radios In[/b]

"Sir, we're within radio range of the air force" the pilot announces to the President.

The President walks towards the built-in radio. "Connect me to air base Dashte-e Shar" the president tells a staffer on board. After a moment, the staffer says "you're connected sir."

"This is President Koroush, do you copy?"

After a few moments of silence, a voice answers "President Koroush, I copy."

"There is a military coup ocurring in the capital. I have begun preparations for a counter-coup and I am enroute to your air base. I need to speak to your captain."

On the other end, the voice answers after a pause, "yes sir, please give me a minute to get him."[/quote]

[B]The Captain[/b]

The captain approaches the receiver with Colonel Jamshid's eyes boring into his back.

"President Koroush, this is Captain Ismail of air force base Dashte-e Shar."

"There is a military coup ocurring in the capital. You must prepare your men and take charge of the surrounding units of the air force and army to enter Shar and arrest General Fereydun and his co-conspirators, do you understand?"

Captain Ismail turns towards Colonel Jamshid who nods. "Yes sir."

"I will be enroute to your air base in approximately 40 minutes. Get this done overtime."

"Yes sir."

"Over and out."

Colonel Jamshid thinks for a moment before radioing General Fereydun.

"President Koroush's plane is enroute to the air base."

"Intercept him, detain him, and then bring him to the Army Headquarters."

"Yes sir."

Colonel Jamshid puts the radio away and orders Captain Ismail to intercept the President under the guise of ensuring his plane's safe passage to the air base. "If he gets suspicious and wants to land elsewhere, you force him to come with. If he deviates from his assigned flight path, you blow him out of the air, got it?"

Captain Ismail sighs and says "yes sir" before leaving with the colonel to get his men ready.

[B]The Interception[/b]

The fighter jets take off and cruise at altitude before radioing in. "This is Squadron Leader Tabari, we have been sent by Captain Ismail of Dashte-e Shar air base to ensure your safe arrival to Dashte-e Shar air base."

After a moment, the pilot radios back "Squadron Leader Tabari, we acknowledge your message. The President orders you to get into a protective formation around the presidential plane."

The fighter jets arrange themselves on all sides of the presidential plane and continue their escort.

[B]Inside the Plane[/b]

Inside the presidential plane, President Koroush is making rapid radio calls to all possible air force bases and some army bases too. Much to his dismay, both his air force captains and the army officers acting in the stead of their absent generals and colonels would not commit themselves to an attack on the capital due to the unknown circumstances on the ground risking escalation.

Nevertheless, President Koroush manages to convince some of them to prepare for an attack on the capital pending his arrival to Dashte-e Shar air base.

Not too long afterwards, his plane lands as expected in Dashte-shar air base. President Koroush leaps out of his seat and quickly makes his way down the stairs, followed by his ministers, only to be encountered by Colonel Jamshid and five soldiers with him, none of whom salute.

The president is unsettled by the lack of respect but nevertheless, glances at his uniform before asking "colonel, there is a coup. How many men do you have with you?"

"President Koroush and Ministers Emam and Jalayer, your government has been dissolved. I am under orders by General Fereydun to detain you and bring you to the army headquarters. I request your cooperation to make this as easy as possible for all of us." With that, Colonel Jamshid orders his men to grab President Koroush and bundle him into the humvee while the ministers are to be zip tied to a chair in the lounge and placed under guard.

With President Koroush secured and the ministers being led away, Colonel Jamshid gets in the humvee and drives to the army headquarters.

[B]President Koroush Resigns[/b]
[I]Two hours later...[/i]

President Koroush is seated at a desk, surrounded by nine other officers of the army, navy, and air force seated in a semi-circle. In the center of the semi-circle, General Fereydun, on the inside two chairs next to General Fereydun are other army generals and on the outer two chairs on both sides are one air force General and one navy admiral each.

"The armed forces have taken over Mr. Koroush. Any resistance will be irresponsible and risk plunging the country into chaos and civil war. We have prepared your resignation statement for you to sign."

President Koroush reads the statement on the desk.

"Recognising that should President Koroush continue to assert his government in the current political situation would be irresponsible, risk fracturing the army, and risk a civil war, President Koroush declares that he formally cedes his administration to the armed forces for a transitionary government to take effect to protect the rights and welfare of Dhornaper and its Citizens."

President Koroush thinks over in silence. Eventually he picks up his pen and signs it before handing it to General Fereydun.

"You will be placed under house arrest until a suitable country is found for you to live in exile" General Fereydun states before getting up to leave. He is followed by the generals and admirals a moment after. President Koroush stays in the room, holding his head in his hands for the next fifteen minutes before being escorted to his home outside Shar.

[spoiler=[b]Wächter-9 Luftabwehrsystem[/b]]

The Sikirskian air force made the costly and deadly mistake of flying headfirst into saturated airspace. A mistake that the Kaiserreich would quickly capitalize on. 

The undamaged anti-air systems including the Wächter-9 stationed both in the Kaiserreichs mainland and newly established holdings in Nestor-Sikirsk would begin to tear the aircraft to shreds. Their interceptor missiles, possessing a significantly longer range than the vast majority of advanced air-to-ground, would lock onto their targets. The undamaged radar systems of the Kaiserreich, utilized by the Kaiserliche Marine, the Kaiserliche Armee and the Marineinfantrie would spot the aircraft in the sky like bright Christmas lights. 

By the hundreds, Wächter-9 batteries would launch their payloads into the skies to slam into the vulnerable Sikirskian aircraft. At 200 km out, the Wächter-9s would be able to hit the Sikirskian aircraft long before they could come close enough to strike their intended targets. Reaching a maximum speed of mach 5, the aircraft wouldnt be able to outrun the missiles as they flew toward the Sikirskian fleet in the hundreds.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Ballistische Raketenabwehr[/b]]

Equally unsuppressed, the vast Kaiserreich ballistic missile defense system would kick into action against the hastily done Sikirskian ICBM strikes. The Reichswehrs Bodenbasierter Abfangrakete or ground based interceptors had been specifically designed to knock ICBMs out of commission. The missiles range thousands of kilometres and are capable of reaching mach 25 to use kinetic force to knock ICBMs out of the skies. 

However, this wouldnt be the only weapon in the Kaiserreich's vast arsenal used to intercept ballistics. Aboard the navy, an equally deadly defender would be deployed against the Sikirskian missiles. The Seeschlange BMD systems, capable of tracking multiple projectiles and deploying the fleet's vast array of weapons, would use the fleet's radars to quickly detect the incoming projectiles. At midcourse they reach mach 15 to slam into the ballistic missiles, deploying in the hundreds to slam the ICBMs with a range of over 2,500 km. 

Even at the terminal stage, the Reichswehr still can intercept the ballistics. At reentry, the Endoatmosphärisches Abfangsystem für ballistische Raketen in großer Höhe system hits the ICBMs with hit-to-kill kinetic mechanisms. 

While the wide ray of anti-ballistic missile systems deployed by the Reichswehr intercept the vast majority of Sikirskian ICBMs, the naval ones arent intercepted. At sea, the Central Military Commission is left perplexed as to why the Sikirskians would launch ICBMs towards naval targets. ICBMs are designed to hit fixed targets such as cities, not a moving fleet. The carrier strike group simply moves slightly and watches the Sikirskian ICBMs plunk into the ocean harmlessly, although it does make for a good fireworks show.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Offensiv Vorgehen: In the Skies[/b]]

Shrugging off the poorly executed and planned Sikirskian attack with minimal casualties while pounding the Sikirskian air fleet with hundreds of interceptor missiles, the Reichswehr goes on the offensive. 

The REG-3000s from the J-16CJs that helped begin the suppression of enemy air defenses continue to be launched into Nestor-Sikirsk, hunting down any enemy radar and air defense system. The loiter drones continue to do their work, diving onto any military radar emissions they detect while staying low to avoid radar detection. Hundreds more are dumped onto Nestor-Sikirskian territory by the Reichswehr. 

Now that the enemy's air defenses have been suppressed, it's time for the Reichswehr to punch a hole in the Sikirskian lines to get to Enkia. 

The TKS Seeschalnge and TKS Seewolf quickly surface, launching their total payloads of 308 Donnerkeil cruise missiles into Nestor-Sikirsk. These precision guided cruise missiles, using terrain tracking, stay low to the ground to remain out of the sight of radars. Their targets include enemy troops, bases, supply depots, fuel supplies, vehicles, air defenses, tanks, runways and other military infrastructure. While the REG-3000s have significantly weakened Sikirskian air defense, tracking their electronic emissions and slamming into them, the Donnerkeils still watch out for the remaining ones. As they approach their targets they spray out chaff, confusing any remaining AA systems by disrupting their lock ons. 

Moving across suppressed air space, long range strategic stealth bombers are employed by the Reichswehr to attack a wide range of targets. To cripple the enemy's warfighting capabilities they drop precision guided munitions onto a wide range of targets including command centers, bridges, roads, factories and logistics hubs. Bombs weighing thousands of pounds rain down from the stealth fighters onto strategic locations, meant to strike the nerve centers of the Sikirskians. 

J-15Es now attack the remaining aircraft that werent shot down by the massive anti-air attack. They launch their payloads before visual range air-to-air missiles, engaging the enemy out of their ranges, using their missiles to chase them down. Using datalink from the more advanced fifth generation aircraft, the missiles are commanded by the J-35s allowing maximum accuracy.[/spoiler] 

[spoiler=[b]Offensiv Vorgehen: Breaking Through to Enkia[/b]]

J-16s do their job as well. Moving across suppressed air space, they move closer and drop massive JDAMs onto the enemy forces attempting to counterattack the Reichswehrs landing forces. The enemy have made the mistake of counterattacking where they do not possess air superiority. The Kaiserliche utilizes this to maximum effect. Attack helicopters slam anti-armor missiles into the Skirskian tanks and APCs well before they are able to reach the Marineinfantrie. Any Sikirskian or enemy infantry in the area will suffer hell from the CBU-87s dropped by the J-16s and attack helicopters. The cluster munitions explode over a large area inflicting maximum damage onto the enemy personnel and severely wounding those who manage to survive. 

The air force doesnt do all the work though. Naval gunfire from the carrier strike group helps the J-16s and attack helicopters as they tear the counterattacking force to shreds. Donnerkeil cruise missiles pound enemy positions with thousands of pounds worth of munitions. While less common, the Kaiserliche Marine also uses their powerful naval guns against the Sikirskians. 5 inch, 127 mm explosive rounds fired onto the Sikirskian forces. 

Utilizing their air superiority, the Reichswehr continuously brings more and more forces into the area. Through constant LCAC sealift and UUVs as well as helicopter airlift a total of 120,000 Reichswehr forces have landed in southwest Nestor-Sikirsk. Now, the force armed with sealifted heavy tanks, infantry fighting vehicles and APCs moves even deeper into Nestor-Sikirskian territory. While engaging any of the surviving Sikirskian troops with massive air support they break through the Sikirskian lines and create a corridor to Enkian forces trapped inland to renew the Enkian war effort. Now, the Technokratisches forces occupy the majority of the southwest of the island.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Kaiserliche Marine[/b]]

With the Sikirskian navy out of the area, the Kaiserliche Marine moves the TKS Seelöwe carrier strike group as well to the area. The two impose a blockade around Nestor-Sikirsk, ready to engage the Sikirskian navy when it arrives. 

Meanwhile once the aircraft carrier is within range, from the Kaiserreichs holdings in the southwest a nasty surprise awaits the Admiral Irkodunsk aircraft carrier. The prized carrier killer missiles launch towards the Admiral Irkodunsk with stunning speed and accuracy. The guided hypersonic ballistic missile is capable of striking within 15 meters of the lock on point. Using its maneuverable reentry capabilities it can move out of the way of interceptor missiles along with its LOAL capabilities guaranteeing it an extra degree of accuracy. Capable of reaching mach 10, its speed makes it extremely hard for any naval interceptor to knock it out of the sky as it approaches the carrier.[/spoiler]

Colonel Jamshid puts the radio away and orders Captain Ismail to intercept the President under the guise of ensuring his plane's safe passage to the air base. "If he gets suspicious and wants to land elsewhere, you force him to come with. If he deviates from his assigned flight path, you blow him out of the air, got it?"

Captain Ismail sighs and says "yes sir" before leaving with the colonel to get his men ready.

[B]The Interception[/b]

The fighter jets take off and cruise at altitude before radioing in. "This is Squadron Leader Tabari, we have been sent by Captain Ismail of Dashte-e Shar air base to ensure your safe arrival to Dashte-e Shar air base."

After a moment, the pilot radios back "Squadron Leader Tabari, we acknowledge your message. The President orders you to get into a protective formation around the presidential plane."

The fighter jets arrange themselves on all sides of the presidential plane and continue their escort.

[B]Inside the Plane[/b]

Inside the presidential plane, President Koroush is making rapid radio calls to all possible air force bases and some army bases too. Much to his dismay, both his air force captains and the army officers acting in the stead of their absent generals and colonels would not commit themselves to an attack on the capital due to the unknown circumstances on the ground risking escalation.

Nevertheless, President Koroush manages to convince some of them to prepare for an attack on the capital pending his arrival to Dashte-e Shar air base.

Not too long afterwards, his plane lands as expected in Dashte-shar air base. President Koroush leaps out of his seat and quickly makes his way down the stairs, followed by his ministers, only to be encountered by Colonel Jamshid and five soldiers with him, none of whom salute.

The president is unsettled by the lack of respect but nevertheless, glances at his uniform before asking "colonel, there is a coup. How many men do you have with you?"

"President Koroush and Ministers Emam and Jalayer, your government has been dissolved. I am under orders by General Fereydun to detain you and bring you to the army headquarters. I request your cooperation to make this as easy as possible for all of us." With that, Colonel Jamshid orders his men to grab President Koroush and bundle him into the humvee while the ministers are to be zip tied to a chair in the lounge and placed under guard.

With President Koroush secured and the ministers being led away, Colonel Jamshid gets in the humvee and drives to the army headquarters.

[B]President Koroush Resigns[/b]
[I]Two hours later...[/i]

President Koroush is seated at a desk, surrounded by nine other officers of the army, navy, and air force seated in a semi-circle. In the center of the semi-circle, General Fereydun, on the inside two chairs next to General Fereydun are other army generals and on the outer two chairs on both sides are one air force General and one navy admiral each.

"The armed forces have taken over Mr. Koroush. Any resistance will be irresponsible and risk plunging the country into chaos and civil war. We have prepared your resignation statement for you to sign."

President Koroush reads the statement on the desk.

"Recognising that should President Koroush continue to assert his government in the current political situation would be irresponsible, risk fracturing the army, and risk a civil war, President Koroush declares that he formally cedes his administration to the armed forces for a transitionary government to take effect to protect the rights and welfare of Dhornaper and its Citizens."

President Koroush thinks over in silence. Eventually he picks up his pen and signs it before handing it to General Fereydun.

"You will be placed under house arrest until a suitable country is found for you to live in exile" General Fereydun states before getting up to leave. He is followed by the generals and admirals a moment after. President Koroush stays in the room, holding his head in his hands for the next fifteen minutes before being escorted to his home outside Shar.[/quote]

[B]A Second Broadcast[/b]

"Citizens, yesterday night the armed forces took control over the administration. In the early hours of this morning, President Koroush landed in Dasht-e Shar air base and then presented himself to the army heaquarters where he formally surrendered his administration.

I have the statement Presdient Koroush signed. It reads:

'Recognising that should President Koroush continue to assert his government in the current political situation would be irresponsible, risk fracturing the army, and risk a civil war, President Koroush declares that he formally cedes his administration to the armed forces for a transitionary government to take effect to protect the rights and welfare of Dhornaper and its Citizens.'

This was signed by President Koroush in the presence of senior generals of the armed forces. As of now, a transitionary government is in effect and is headed by myself, General Fereydun.

To all Citizens, your rights and duties will not change, you may continue your daily responsibilities as normal."

General Fereydun makes a motion for the broadcast to end and then radios Colonel Jamshid to order his men at other broadcasters to play it over once and restore network connectivity across the country.

The coup was nearly complete.

[B]Officers Assemble[/b]
[I]12:00[/i]

General Fereydun turns to one of the senior staffers in the general staff. "Is every admiral, general and colonel across the country here?"

"Sir, everyone we could contact on such short notice is here."

"Good enough, contact everyone else too, I will meet with them in private at a later date."

"Yes sir."

With that interaction done, he walks back onto the army headquarters auditorium for a second time today.

"Officers of Dhornaper's military, you are all aware that the armed forces has taken control over the administration and instituted a transitionary government following former President Koroush's resignation.

I offer anyone who disagrees with the decision an option. You can announce here your resignation from the armed forces and retire without prejudice and with a a year's salary."

After a moment of silence in which, as he predicted, no one spoke up, he continued.

"The armed forces will continue as normal. The head of the transitionary will be myself and all the rights and liberties of the Citizens will be respected and all duties and responsibilities of the armed forces maintained. You are all dismissed to return to your regular duties."

With his power over the military consolidated, the risk of a counter coup was neutralised.

General Fereydun's coup was complete without a shot being fired or a single person killed or injured.
